findings.title: Canonical verify-only row counts can be overridden
findings.description: verify_dataset_shape correctly defaults to 140352 train rows and 39152 test rows, but expected_train_rows and expected_test_rows take precedence and are exposed as CLI flags. This permits a shortened artifact and matching manifest to pass the supposed canonical verify-only gate. Remove the production override path; keep test isolation through a controlled test seam if needed.

findings.title: Manifest replacement failure does not roll back the test tape
findings.description: When os.replace(staged_manifest, manifest_path) fails after both tape replacements, the handler restores train and the pre-existing/absent manifest but never backs up or restores test. The resulting test tape can be new while train and manifest are old. Add test backup/restore or another transaction-safe publication strategy, and test final manifest failure for both manifest states.

notes: Independent task review. The deterministic package reports verification passed, but source review finds two blocking failure modes: row-count bypass through new public overrides and incomplete rollback when final manifest publication fails.
